components.purpose: The whole 'Get a quote' section: its Heading (e.g. 'Get a quote'), Description, and the form itself, with the Submit URL, success/error/loading messages. Placed in body or bottom, and it is the only component needed. Caveat: the model has no name, company or project-details fields; it only holds heading, description, submit URL, messages, and office address/phone/email. The name, company and project fields would have to be defined on the submit endpoint or the form. FormBuilder and AgilityFormBuilder are hidden (isVisible: false), so they aren't options.
